precedence: separate module/application variants; do not collapse with generic DTC
notes: SSM/TBS evidence identifies the code, ECU and condition; it does not always define SAE standard meaning

entries.definition_en: Steering-related DTC C1B00, failure subtype 62 (exact official base-code definition not provided in bulletin)
entries.translation_ar: خلل مرتبط بالتوجيه — الرمز الفرعي 62؛ التعريف المعياري الكامل غير موثق في النشرة

source.title: Ford TSB 21-2252
source.source_scope: Ford 2020–2021 Escape, not Sweden/EU fitment proof

entries.observed_service_condition: Stability/traction warning; steering wheel-to-column shaft alignment and unequal tie rod length
diagnostic_steps: Read PSCM C1B00:62 and ABS C0051:67
Inspect tie rod threading lengths for gross asymmetry per TSB
If criteria met, have qualified technician inspect wheel/column alignment and follow Ford WSM and TSB procedure
After correct alignment and toe adjustment, perform Ford recalibration road test

entries.definition_en: C0051 failure type 67 in ABS; full failure-type standard definition not verified here
entries.translation_ar: عطل ABS برمز C0051 والنوع الفرعي 67؛ تعريف النوع الكامل يحتاج توثيقاً
entries.observed_service_condition: Same Ford TSB 21-2252 steering shaft alignment issue; accompanies PSCM C1B00:62
diagnostic_steps: Confirm ABS C0051:67 and PSCM C1B00:62 co-occur
Inspect steering mechanical alignment and toe per TSB
Follow qualified Ford Workshop Manual procedures before replacing sensors

entries.definition_en: C1B00 failure type 62 in PSCM with driver-assist warnings; base code definition not given in SSM
entries.translation_ar: رمز C1B00 النوع 62 في وحدة التوجيه مع رسائل أنظمة المساعدة
entries.observed_service_condition: Pre-collision, Hill Start Assist, AdvanceTrac and blind-spot messages; Ford attributes some cases to PSCM software
diagnostic_steps: Confirm 2023 F-Super Duty identity and exact PSCM stored code
Check SSM 52105 criteria and software level
If within bulletin scope, reprogram PSCM using supported Ford diagnostics; otherwise WSM diagnosis

entries.definition_en: Adaptive/Active Steering message with C1B00 stored in SECM; full DTC definition not specified
entries.translation_ar: خلل توجيه متكيف/نشط مع تسجيل C1B00 في وحدة التحكم بجهد التوجيه
entries.observed_service_condition: Adaptive/active steering warning; Ford TSB 16-2066 for Edge with active steering
diagnostic_steps: Confirm adaptive/active steering equipment and SECM C1B00
Check exact TSB criteria and VIN applicability
Follow WSM 211-02 and specific TSB; no blanket replacement outside scope

entries.definition_en: Power steering module C1B00 recorded after SCCM/GSM programming; official base-code definition not specified
entries.translation_ar: تسجيل C1B00 في وحدة التوجيه الكهربائي بعد برمجة وحدة عمود المقود أو اختيار التروس

source.title: Ford SSM 55298
source.source_scope: Ford Explorer and Police Interceptor Utility 2025–2027, condition post-update

entries.observed_service_condition: Possible steering assist warning following SCCM/GSM update
diagnostic_steps: Confirm recent SCCM or GSM software update and DTC source module
Follow Ford SSM 55298 exact reset procedure for vehicle type
Do not infer mechanical steering failure solely from this code

source.title: Ford SSM 55298
source.source_scope: 2025–2027 Ford Explorer and Police Interceptor Utility

entries.observed_service_condition: Condition after programming SCCM/GSM; Ford specifies reset path
diagnostic_steps: Verify update history and PSCM U2016
Use Ford SSM 55298 appropriate power reset instructions and hybrid battery precautions
If the bulletin does not apply, follow WSM communication diagnosis

source.source_scope: 2025–2027 Ford Explorer and Police Interceptor Utility

entries.observed_service_condition: TRON Module Authentication referenced by Ford SSM 55298
diagnostic_steps: Verify U211B is stored in PSCM and recent module reprogramming
Use Ford FDRS TRON Module Authentication application and documented repair sequence
Do not replace hardware before completing Ford authentication diagnosis
